privateAiMode.title: Private vs Smart
privateAiMode.description: Private mode runs AI only on this device — summaries and tasks stay on your phone and aren't sent to our servers. Smart mode uses the cloud for extra features and is usually faster.
privateAiMode.enableAlertMessage:
Maximum privacy.

All data, including transcripts, is processed only on this device.

What to expect:
• May run more slowly
• Higher battery use
• Some features aren't available

You can switch back to Smart mode anytime.
